documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot
Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On November 14, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: In its Q2 FY27 earnings call, OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited reported an AUM growth of 68.4% year-on-year to Rs. 9,317 crore and profit after tax of Rs. 125 crore. Management raised its FY27 AUM growth guidance from over 40% to over 60% while targeting a reduction in impairment costs of more than 15% year-on-year. The company completed a preferential allotment of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management raised its FY27 AUM growth guidance from over 40% to over 60%.
guidance.quote: Given the momentum in the first half, we are raising our FY27 AUM growth guidance from 40% plus to 60% plus.

guidance.claim: Management expects impairment costs to reduce by more than 15% year-on-year.
guidance.quote: We are now saying it will be emphatically more than 15% reduction year on year.

guidance.claim: Management maintained its guidance of return on average equity above 20% and gross NPA below 2.25%.
guidance.quote: The rest of our guidance stands : return on average equity would be above 20%, and the gross NPA below 2.25%.

guidance.claim: Management reaffirmed its guidance of a 15% reduction in credit cost.
guidance.quote: We firmly hold to our guidance which we gave last quarter, which is 15% reduction in credit cost, and we are tracking well on that.

guidance.claim: Management is confident of over-delivering on the overall AUM growth guidance of upwards of 40% for the next 12 months.
guidance.quote: So the point I was making on guidance is we remain firmly confident of over-delivering on the number that we had given last quarter of 40%.

demand_outlook.claim: Retail loan sanctions across the industry grew by nearly 20% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Across the industry, retail loan sanctions are up by nearly 20% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: FMCG value growth reached a six-quarter high of 8.6% in Q2.
demand_outlook.quote: FMCG value growth hit a six-quarter high of 8.6% in Q2.

demand_outlook.claim: E-commerce festive season sales grew by 20-22%.
demand_outlook.quote: E-commerce festive season sales are up 20-22%.

demand_outlook.claim: Electricity consumption increased by 11.4% in September.
demand_outlook.quote: Electricity consumption rose 11.4% in September, a strong signal of industrial activity.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term opportunity in India for digital credit remains unmistakably gargantuan.
demand_outlook.quote: Beyond the ebb and flow of any single quarter, the long-term opportunity in India remains unmistakably gargantuan.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry-wide bureau data shows a clear divergence with stress building up in small ticket loans or among borrowers carrying debt across multiple lenders.
demand_outlook.quote: The bureau data for the industry now shows a clear divergence beneath a calm surface.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian economy remains steady, which is what a lender values the most.
demand_outlook.quote: On the macro picture, the Indian economy remains steady, and, as you know, this steadiness is what a lender like us values the most.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operates across 107 LAP branches in 9 states and union territories.
capex_expansion.quote: We now operate across 107 branches in 9 states and union territories.

capex_expansion.claim: The Loan Against Property (LAP) business stands at INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states.
capex_expansion.quote: LAP business which we started two years back, the AUM stands at INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states, about 7.7% of the total AUM.

capex_expansion.claim: The subsidiary has secured an AMFI registration to build capabilities in mutual fund distribution.
capex_expansion.quote: Our subsidiary has secured an AMFI registration already.

margins_costs.claim: The company's average cost of borrowing decreased by approximately 70 basis points to 13.76%.
margins_costs.quote: Even as borrowing costs rise across the system, our cost of borrowing has fallen by approximately 70 basis points, from 14.45% to 13.76%.

margins_costs.claim: Total finance cost as a share of average AUM dropped by 100 basis points quarter-on-quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The total finance cost, as a share of average AUM, has also fallen by 100 basis points quarter on quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Credit costs fell to 6.2% of average AUM compared to 6.8% in the previous quarter and 9.3% a year ago.
margins_costs.quote: Credit costs fell to 6.2% of average AUM, from 6.8% last quarter and 9.3% a year ago.

margins_costs.claim: Pre-provisioning operating profit increased by 40% year-on-year to Rs. 287 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Pre-provisioning operating profit was Rs. 287 crores, up 40% year-on-year, and 12% quarter on quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Credit cost dropped to 6.80% of average AUM from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Credit cost was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Opex as a proportion of AUM has come down from 19.9% to 18.0%.
margins_costs.quote: You must have seen the operating leverage some evidence of that, 19.9% cost which was opex as a proportion of AUM has already come down to 18.0% percent.

orders_capacity.claim: Total AUM reached Rs. 9,317 crore, growing 68.4% year-on-year and 16.4% quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: AUM reached Rs. 9,317 crore, up 68.4% year-on-year, and 16.4% quarter on quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Disbursements rose by 56% year-on-year to Rs. 4,612 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Disbursements were Rs. 4,612 crore, up 56% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: LAP AUM reached Rs. 737 crore, representing 7.9% of total AUM.
orders_capacity.quote: AUM is Rs. 737 crore, or 7.9% of the total, up from 4.1% a year ago.

orders_capacity.claim: Registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million.
orders_capacity.quote: The registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has served 12.25 million customers, an increase of 26% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have now served 12.25 million customers, an increase of 26% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Disbursements for the quarter were INR 3,812 crores, up 37% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Disbursement for the quarter were INR 3,812 crores, up 37% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The split between on-book AUM and off-book AUM stood at a 46:54 ratio.
orders_capacity.quote: On-book AUM of INR 3,716 crores and off-book AUM of INR 4,284 crores, a 46:54 split, supported by more than 45 lending partners.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a preferential allotment of Rs. 832 crore following shareholder approval.
capital_allocation.quote: We also completed a preferential allotment of Rs. 832 crore, approved by shareholders at the EGM on 14th October, and subsequently received in-principle approval from the exchanges.

capital_allocation.claim: Seventy-five percent of the preferential issue proceeds will be infused into the subsidiary to support growth.
capital_allocation.quote: 75% will go as infusion into our subsidiary to fund our balance sheet and increase our support, our growth.

capital_allocation.claim: Twenty-five percent of preferential issue proceeds will go toward corporate expenses and AI investments.
capital_allocation.quote: The remaining 25% will go as a combination of corporate expenses, particularly the investment in AI that we continue to keep doing.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised ₹832.2 crore via a preferential equity issue.
Capital adequacy in the NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% in the previous quarter following the IPO.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital adequacy in our NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, nearly four times its level in March 2023.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, nearly four times its level in March 2023, built on retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company identified gold loan exposure as a risk in September 2025 and restricted lending to gold loan borrowers.
risks_headwinds.quote: We flagged rising gold loan exposure as a risk in September 2025, and 13 months back began restricting lending to consumers carrying gold loan.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company patched all systems against the PHP2Shell critical weakness.
risks_headwinds.quote: On cybersecurity, all our systems are fully patched against PHP2Shell, the critical PHP weakness flagged by cybersecurity agencies last week.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted West Asia risks relating to potential transmission through higher oil prices, shipping costs, and customer confidence.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first is West Asia, where the risk is not geography but transmission through higher oil prices, the cost of shipping, and, over time, the confidence of the customer.

risks_headwinds.claim: Stage 2 asset quality stood at 3.15%, improving from 3.9% year-on-year.
risks_headwinds.quote: Stage 2 stood at 3.15%. Stage 2 has improved from 3.9% to 3.15% year-on-year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gross NPA stood at 2.25% and Net NPA at 0.36%, with collection efficiency at 96.82%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Gross NPA at 2.25%, very range bound. Net NPA at 0.36% and collection efficiency at 96.82%, which shows our resilience to risk management.

management_commitments.claim: Management raised its FY27 AUM growth target from 40% plus to 60% plus.
management_commitments.quote: Given the momentum in the first half, we are raising our FY27 AUM growth guidance from 40% plus to 60% plus.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets more than a 15% year-on-year reduction in impairment costs.
management_commitments.quote: We are now saying it will be emphatically more than 15% reduction year on year.

management_commitments.claim: Management projects the LAP business to grow 2.5 times over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: So, all in all, to your question, the growth rate is going to be almost, in next two years, 2.5 times of what we are today.

management_commitments.claim: Management guides that the cost of borrowing will drop by a minimum of 100 basis points in the second half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So our guidance for FY, particularly H2 of FY27, that you will see the cost of borrowing dropping by 100 basis points and it will only increase as we, as the old debt basically runs off the book, right?

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the Loan Against Property business to achieve breakeven around Q3 of this year.
management_commitments.quote: Somewhere around Q3 of this year, it will only be delivering the desired ROE for which we started the business.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
